Name: Better Beehouses
Author: tlitookilakin
Description:
[center][/center]
Better Beehouses aims to make bee houses more versatile, more usable, and all around better. Current features include:
[list]
[*]They can produce honey indoors
[*]They can produce honey during winter
[*]They can use flowers planted in pots
[*]Change the rate at which they produce honey
[*]Change the range to search for flowers
[*]Allow using forage flowers
[*]Change the value of honey with a multiplier
[*]Allow honey to have quality
[*]Fancy bee particles with Particle Effects mod
[*]Allow using giant crops
[*]Allow using trees (Thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/114762643]CopperSun[/url]﻿ for this idea)
[*]Allow using bushes
[*]Cosmetic bees
[*]Option to select a random flower instead of the nearest one
[*]Increase output amount based on the number of nearby flowers
[*]Visual overlay showing which flowers a beehouse can reach (F9 to toggle by default)
[/list]
Supports the following languages:
[list]
[*]Ukrainian ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/80961158]ChulkyBow[/url]﻿)
[*]Portuguese ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/148478623]c4ttzinhaa[/url]﻿)
[*]Chinese ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/132842668]TangKeke[/url]﻿)
[/list][center][/center]
Better Beehouses can be configured using the config.json file in the mod folder, or in game with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]﻿! GMCM updates INSTANTLY, (as soon as you hit save,) so feel free to take a look at the options and customize to your heart's desire!


[size=4]Fully Compatible[/size]
[list]
[*]Automate: Beehouses can be automated, and better beehouses settings will apply.
[*]Range Highlight: Fully integrated. Shows adjusted range of bee houses.
[*]Wildflowers Reimagined: Fully integrated.
[*]Honey Harvest Sync: Full compatibility.

[/list]
[size=4]Partially Compatible[/size]
[list]
[*]Producer Framework Mod: To prevent tampering, Better Beehouses prevents the bee house from being registered as a producer. Most of the time, this should be a non-issue, since bee houses only produce honey anyways. Honey settings should work with PFM machines, but other settings will not.
[*]Data Layers: Data Layers will not show the adjusted range.
[/list]
[size=4]Incompatible[/size]
[list]
[*]Bee Paths: this is now also a feature of Better Beehouses.
[/list]
[center][/center]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿.
[*]Unzip this mod into the Mods folder.
[/list]
[center][/center]
